name: Diabetic Hospital Diet (Consistent Carbohydrate)
description: Consistent-carbohydrate meal pattern for inpatients with diabetes.

rules.title: Carbohydrate per main meal
rules.evidence: Common hospital consistent-carbohydrate order: 45–60 g per main meal.

rules.title: Carbohydrate per snack
rules.evidence: Common hospital order: 15–30 g per snack.

rules.title: No sugar-sweetened beverages
rules.evidence: ADA Standards of Care: consistent carbohydrate intake across meals; limit sugar-sweetened beverages; ~14 g fiber per 1,000 kcal.

rules.title: No high-sugar desserts or sweetened foods
rules.evidence: ADA Standards of Care: consistent carbohydrate intake across meals; limit sugar-sweetened beverages; ~14 g fiber per 1,000 kcal.

rules.title: Added sugar share of energy
rules.evidence: Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020–2025: sodium <2,300 mg/day; saturated fat <10% and added sugars <10% of energy.
